storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP MyFreeCams Downloader makes it easy to capture live streams and download recordings from MyFreeCams.com.

How it works: Go to any model's page on MyFreeCams while the stream is live, then click the download button on the player or the extension icon. The extension discovers the HLS stream across multiple CDN hosts, shows available quality options, and captures it as a standard MP4 file. For recorded videos, navigate to the model's video page and download directly.

It handles live HLS capture, multi-CDN host probing, Mouflon key decoding, and VR metadata automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Videos save directly to your Downloads folder in an organized MYFREECAMS subfolder.

Key features:
- Live stream capture with start/stop controls
- VOD recording downloads from model profiles
- Multi-CDN host probing (doppiocdn, stripcdn, sc-cdn, and more)
- In-page download button right on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Quality selection from all available resolutions
- VR stream support with metadata preservation
- Real-time download progress with segment counter and elapsed time
- Right-click context menu for quick capture
- Dark-themed UI with coral pink accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to MyFreeCams.com and open a model's page
3. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon
4. Select quality and start capture — saved as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I capture a live stream?
faq.answer: Go to any model's page on MyFreeCams.com while the stream is live. Click the download button on the player or the extension icon. Select your quality and click Start. The extension captures the stream in real time. Click Stop when you're done — it saves as MP4.

faq.question: Can I download recorded videos?
faq.answer: Yes. Navigate to a model's video page and use the extension to download the recording directly.

faq.question: What quality options are available?
faq.answer: The extension detects all available qualities from the HLS master manifest — typically multiple resolutions up to the source quality. Formats are sorted by quality (highest first).

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Videos automatically save to a MYFREECAMS subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Does it support VR streams?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects VR metadata (stereoPacking, frameFormat, horizontalAngle) and preserves it in the filename.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding the stream?
faq.answer: Make sure the model is online and the stream is live. If the model is offline or in a private show, the extension will display a status message. Refresh the page and try again.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
